task: Persian intent classification on MASSIVE fa-IR

variants.normalized: NFC; Arabic Yeh/Kaf canonicalization; remove tatweel and Arabic diacritics; collapse whitespace; preserve ZWNJ and punctuation

selection_metric: Mean validation Macro-F1 across three seeds
note: This is a validation-only robustness/normalization experiment. Do not describe these values as Test performance. GPU kernels may retain minor nondeterminism despite fixed seeds.
